shorts.title: $113,000 of Solid Gold Pokémon Cards 🤯
shorts.description:
Pokémon China just revealed 30 Pikachu cards made of 99.9% pure gold, one for every Pikachu in the 30th Celebration set. 30 grams each, about $3,765 in gold per card. But you can't buy them. Would you buy one, or is it just a flex? 👇
#pokemon #pokemontcg #pikachu #pokemoncards #thecardwall

shorts.title: $1,450 To $898. Pokémon Prices Are Falling Fast.
shorts.description:
The biggest modern Pokémon chase card, the Umbreon ex from Prismatic Evolutions, sold for $1,450 in September. Today on eBay it's going for $898.
 
And it's not just Umbreon. The Mega Rayquaza ex from Delta Reign hit $398 on release day. Two weeks later, $284. The 30th Celebration Night box went from $724 to $350.

shorts.title: $630,000 For A Pokémon Card That Was Never Released
shorts.description:
In 1998, before Pokémon cards came to America, Wizards of the Coast made a special galaxy holo Blastoise to pitch the game to Nintendo. It's one of only two known Blastoise presentation cards.

On Friday, this one in a CGC 8.5 sold on Fanatics for $630,000 after 59 bids, a new record for any Blastoise card.

shorts.title: This Pokémon Card Lost $16,600 in 2 Months
shorts.description:
The first blue RGB Mew from Pokémon 30th Celebration sold for $20,000 on eBay before the set even hit shelves. Collectors thought the card was a hoax. Now the same blue Mew sells for about $3,400. Was $20,000 the top, or is $3,400 the steal of the year?

#pokemon #pokemoncards #pokemontcg #rgbmew #30thcelebration

shorts.title: Fake Walmart Driver Caught With $2,000 in Pokémon
shorts.description: Police say a man signed up as a Walmart Spark driver, picked up customers' orders and kept them. When they pulled over his Tesla in Wisconsin, they found 125 packs of Pokémon 30th Celebration, 26 anniversary tins, 112 One Piece packs and a Rayquaza LEGO set, about $2,000 at today's prices. Police think he hit stores in three states. Would you still trust a delivery driver with your Pokémon cards?

shorts.title: Pokémon Just Revealed Z Mega Evolution Cards
shorts.description:
Pokémon just announced Flowing Fists, the first English set with Z Mega Evolution cards, landing February 6. Mega Lucario Z ex leads the set with Mega Garchomp Z ex and Mega Absol Z ex right behind it, and Japan gets them first in Aura Seeker on November 27. The last Mega set's top card is already a $295 Rayquaza. Next big chase or just another gimmick?
 
#pokemon #pokemoncards #pokemontcg #flowin
